newsitem.title: USA: H.B. Fuller says CEO Kissling to retire.
newsitem.headline: H.B. Fuller says CEO Kissling to retire.

text.p: H.B. Fuller Co said Friday President and Chief Executive Walter Kissling would retire in April 1998.

The company said Kissling will be 67 years old upon retirement. Until then, Kissling's focus will be on "significantly improving our operating performance according to the profitability improvement plan that was initiated at the end of 1995," Tony Andersen, H.B. Fuller's chairman, said in a statement.
"We are making this announcement now, nine months in advance of Walter's retirement to assure an orderly and thoughtful transition of leadership and management within our company," Andersen said.
The company said it planned to announce a successor after the first of the year.
H.B. Fuller shares closed down 1/4 at 50 Friday.
